messages:
Sam Lee: Quick sync on BlueHarbor POC — they want a short perf validation: sustained 2k QPS, target p95 < 120ms at 512 tokens. Can we run a smoke then a 30m soak?
Ira Chen: Yep. Need to confirm model & region. Are they ok w/ rwd-gpt-small-q8 in us-west-2?
Devon Patel: Also flag from security: their questionnaire insists on AES-HSM keywrap for customer keys. Won't change runtime perf but onboarding takes extra day.
Sam Lee: Confirmed: model = rwd-gpt-small-q8, primary region us-west-2, fallback us-east-1 only if capacity is needed.
Ira Chen: Proposed runbook: 1) 5m smoke ramp to 200 QPS, 2) 10m ramp phases to 2k, 3) 30m steady 2k with 1% Poisson jitter, 4) 10m cooldown. Capture token-level latencies and batch sizes.
Sophia Gomez: I'll add trace tags so we can correlate route decisions and batch IDs. Need the exact load generator command.
Ira Chen: Use wrk2 + lua payload; sample:
```bash
wrk -t8 -c600 -d00:30 -s ./scripts/blueharbor_payload.lua --latency https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```
Lua script picks prompt lengths per distro and sets X-Model: rwd-gpt-small-q8 header.
Sam Lee: Prompt distro for cost calc: 60% short (40 tokens), 30% mid (150 tokens), 10% long (400 tokens). Avg response ~120 tokens.
Devon Patel: For pricing I'll need tokens consumed for the 30m + a 24/7 projection at 2k QPS. Sales wants hosted POC quote and a monthly committed price for dedicated capacity.
Sophia Gomez: Results we must include: p50/p95/p99 token latency, tokens/sec, GPU utilization, batch-size distribution, KV-cache hit rate, fallback invocations. I'll draft a one-pager exec summary.
Sam Lee: Ops Q: will continuous batching be active? That affects tail.
Ira Chen: Yes. Pool config: continuous batching enabled, max batch 64, batch timeout 6ms. We'll log per-batch sizes.
Devon Patel: BlueHarbor legal asked about data retention during POC. Can we set ephemeral logs TTL and enable PII redaction?
Sam Lee: We can set logs TTL = 7 days and enable request/response redaction for this tenant. Ops approval needed.
ops-bot: @channel Canary pool deployed at 6312345780, full pool ready at 6312345794. Perf-smoke job queued. :rocket:
Sam Lee: Can we simulate regional network variance (50ms) for 5m during steady to check failover triggering?
Ira Chen: Yes, I'll schedule a netem rule on one client during minute 10-15 of the steady phase.
Sophia Gomez: Add a budget stop: soft throttle at 2.2k QPS and hard stop if token spend > $1500 for the run (sales requested). Also add Slack alert to #sales-blueharbor.
Devon Patel: I'll prepare two price lines: 1) Hosted POC (one-off run + short-term burst buffer) 2) Dedicated commit pricing for 2k sustained (monthly). Will send draft invoice after CSVs.
Ira Chen: Running smoke now — 200 QPS pass looks clean. Initial metrics: p95 ~ 95ms, GPU util 40%. Ramp to 2k starting.
ops-bot: perf-smoke-blueharbor: ramp steps completed, steady phase entered at 6312345798.
Sophia Gomez: Early 60s sample: p50 33ms, p95 118ms, p99 245ms, tokens/sec ~59k, KV hit 69%. Recording full 30m.
Devon Patel: Good. Once Sophia posts CSVs I'll build the cost breakdown and a short chart for sales.
Sam Lee: Thanks team — please log any anomalies in the ticket https://redwood.example/t/POC-1234 and well sync after soak. :thumbsup:"
